title: heterosperma nanum
intro: Heterosperma nanum, commonly known as Chiltepin or Mexican Pepperdgrass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. It is native to Mexico and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, stress, and inflammation. The health benefits of Heterosperma nanum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
